[ISBK.2.2] The mode-specific fields are **reused** across backends; the backend
dispatches on its own `atom_field` and reads only the fields meaningful to it —
e.g. `element_type` (the ring buffer, the FIFO deque and the monotonic deque),
`max_samples` (ring cap / reservoir k). `time_model` and `gap_policy` are read
by the numeric integral alone ([LSIG.2.3.6]) and are `0` for every other
backing.
